en.headline: Kai Tak water festival and dragon boat races run through Sunday
en.dek: The second HEY! Water Festival continues at Runway 1331 on the former airport strip, with a full day of racing after Saturday's opening.
body: The second HEY! Water Festival and the Dream Blue Cup intercity dragon boat races continue through Sunday at Runway 1331 on Shing Fung Road, at the seaward end of the old Kai Tak runway.

Organisers said Saturday's opening drew more than 800 paddlers and several thousand visitors. Forty-six local and mainland crews are entered. A paddle-board challenge was held on Saturday morning; dragon boat racing continues through Sunday. Winning crews are to receive support to race in Suqian, Jiangsu, at next year's Dragon Boat Festival.

The programme also includes a Suqian cultural display, a market, stage performances and water-play areas along the harbourfront site. The venue is a converted former community isolation facility now used as a youth and events precinct.

Sunday falls on a public holiday weekend after Mid-Autumn. Visitors heading to Kai Tak were advised to allow extra time in the heat, with a Very Hot Weather Warning in force and the city's football team also playing at Kai Tak Stadium from 3pm.

zh.headline: 啟德Hey水節及龍舟賽週日續舉行
zh.dek: 第二屆香港Hey水節連同連城龍舟賽在啟航1331進行至今日，周六已有逾800名健兒參賽。
body: 第二屆香港Hey水節暨夢之藍盃連城龍舟賽今日繼續在啟德承豐道啟航1331舉行，地點位於舊機場跑道海端。
主辦單位表示，周六開幕已有逾800名水上運動健兒及數千名市民到場，共46支本地及內地隊伍參賽。平板賽艇挑戰賽已於周六上午舉行，龍舟賽事週日全日繼續。各組別冠軍將獲資助，明年端午代表香港前往江蘇宿遷作體育交流。
活動另設宿遷文化展示、市集、舞臺表演及親水區。場地由前社區隔離設施活化而成，現作青年及活動用途。
今日仍屬中秋假期周末。酷熱天氣警告生效，加上港隊下午三時亦在啟德主場館作賽，前往啟德的市民宜預留較多交通及防暑時間。
